title: StarkStorm
tagline: StarkStorm: Decentralized P2P lending bridging traditional finance and crypto, offering customizable loans and robust infrastructure on Starknet
description: StarkStorm is a decentralized lending platform on the STARKNET blockchain. It offers customizable loans and robust infrastructure, enabling efficient peer-to-peer lending. The platform enhances financial inclusion by bridging the gap between traditional finance and the crypto market. Key participants include depositors, lenders, and borrowers. StarkStorm addresses restrictive banking systems and poor APYs, providing better financial tools for emerging markets.
how_its_made:
Development Tools:
Scarb: Version 2.5.4 is used for building and managing the Starknet smart contracts.
Starknet Foundry: Version 0.23.0 is used for testing and deploying contracts on Starknet.
Cairo: Version 2.5.4, Starknet's native programming language for writing smart contracts.
Rpc: Version 0.5.1 for JSON-RPC communication with the Starknet Devnet.

We have used scaffold stark to build this application
